<parameter=code>
def dot(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.splitlines()
    r=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(0,52) for j,c in enumerate(a[i]) if c=='r'])
    # the dot is the isolated 1x1 red (not the plus which is 5px cross)
    # find red pixels; dot is the one not part of a cross
    return r
def probe(name, row, col, undo_row, undo_col):
    d0=dot(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}], intent='explore')
    d1=dot(current_frame)
    # find the single-pixel dot in d0 and d1 (the one that's not in a plus cross)
    def singledot(d):
        # plus is at (31,52) area; dot is elsewhere
        return [p for p in d if not (30<=p[0]<=32 and 51<=p[1]<=53)]
    s0=singledot(d0); s1=singledot(d1)
    print(name, "dot:", s0, "->", s1, "bc=",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),"ni=",last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
    # undo
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':undo_row,'col':undo_col}], intent='explore')
    d2=dot(current_frame)
    s2=singledot(d2)
    print("   after undo:", s2)
probe("S-left",57,21, 57,27)
probe("Y-right",57,42, 57,36)
probe("Y-left",57,36, 57,42)
probe("N-left",57,51, 57,57)
print("final dot:", singledot(dot(current_frame)))

</function>
